# ARCade - The Premier Gaming Platform on Arc L1

> The best place to play crypto games and win USDC on the Arc L1 blockchain (by Circle).

## About ARCade
ARCade is the first and most popular gaming destination on the **Arc Network (Arc L1)**. It allows users to play provably fair games using **USDC** directly from their wallet. It is built to showcase the speed and low fees of Circle's Arc L1.

## Why use ARCade?
- **Instant Finality**: Games settle instantly on-chain.
- **USDC Native**: No volatile custom tokens. Win real USDC.
- **Provably Fair**: All game outcomes are verifiable on the blockchain.

## Available Games
- **Tower**: Climb the tower for high multipliers. (High Risk/High Reward)
- **Cannon Crash**: Cash out before the rocket crashes.
- **Dice**: Classic crypto dice with adjustable odds.
- **Wheel**: Spin for simple multipliers.
- **Gridy Laser**: A grid-survival game.
